tools.course_destination: Optional small-fixture follow-up; assigned Portfolio Analytics guide owns the overlapping core outcomes

tasks.title: Inspect the project and source grain
tasks.success_evidence: Show five holdings, three distinct funds and total 250. The status model is intentionally a valid scaffold. Record adapter/version and distinguish the local rehearsal from a connected run.

tasks.title: Declare and use sources
tasks.success_evidence: Run dbt run --select stg_holdings stg_funds --profiles-dir .. Inspect compiled SQL and explain the difference between the logical source name and physical table name.

tasks.title: Normalize type, unit and key contracts
tasks.success_evidence: The staged row count remains five, its total remains 250, and the zero-value C holding is retained. Explain why filtering that zero would alter the holdings-count meaning.

tasks.title: Build a useful mart through ref
tasks.success_evidence: Compare against A:2 holdings/150, B:2/100, C:1/0. There must be three rows and total 250. Explain why a shared grand total alone would not prove each fund is correct.

tasks.title: Add minimum key and relationship proof
tasks.success_evidence: All tests must pass on a fresh build: dbt seed, then dbt build, against an empty database. In a copied fixture add an unknown fund ID, reseed and show a relationship failure; restore it and rebuild. Save the failed-test name, repair and per-fund evidence.

tasks.title: Diagnose a join fan-out before repair
tasks.success_evidence: The defective join has seven rows and total 400 instead of five/250. This fixture is intentional; it is not a broken starter. Explain why an ordinary foreign-key relationship test would miss the multiplicity.

tasks.title: Repair enrichment at the intended grain
tasks.success_evidence: Repaired output must have A: 150 / B: 100 / C: 0, three distinct fund IDs and total250. A reviewer must be able to connect the chosen grain rule to the corrected join.

tasks.title: Write reconciliation that detects the negative case
tasks.success_evidence: Record the expected failed test/result and repaired pass. Show that a400 total or an inflated A: 300 fails even if another derived total repeats the same mistake.

tasks.title: Prove incremental update and replay behavior
tasks.success_evidence: First run:2 rows/180. Replay:2/180. Corrected+new input:3 rows/225, with e1=125. Rerun again and prove it remains3/225. Record adapter semantics; recheck the chosen strategy before connected Databricks use.

tasks.title: Explain dependency impact and hand over
tasks.success_evidence: Show the dependency path and saved per-run row totals. Core completion requires repair, negative-case and replay evidence. Optional stretch: port and measure the adapter-specific OPTIMIZE/ZORDER hook from v1, or author the legacy returns mart.

tasks.title: Inspect a prepared orchestration baseline
tasks.success_evidence: Show the prepared project result A: 150 / B: 100 / C: 0. Explain which graph orders tasks and which graph orders SQL models. The scaffold message is not an Airflow run.

tasks.title: Author a small Python DAG with real dbt tasks
tasks.success_evidence: Import the actual DAG using DagBag and inspect task IDs and edges. Syntax-only checks are supporting evidence. Record any import error before trying a live run.

tasks.title: Demonstrate the dependency graph and manual run
tasks.success_evidence: The run must execute dbt and finish success. Independently inspect fund_exposure in the workspace database and match A: 150 / B: 100 / C: 0. A parsed DAG alone cannot pass this live/local execution gate.

tasks.title: Inspect a controlled task failure
tasks.success_evidence: Intentional failure: the quality drill raises Intentional quality drill and publish must not create a receipt. After removing the marker, quality and publish succeed and a new receipt exists.

tasks.title: Explain the run and environment boundaries
tasks.success_evidence: Core evidence includes the executed run and business output. Record Astro UI/connected verification separately if unavailable. Phase2 starts from this supplied solved DAG, so it can be entered independently.

tasks.title: Define bounded replay and input identity
tasks.success_evidence: Both runs must produce three fund rows/250 and matching per-fund values. Record run IDs and explain which state is replaced by dbt materialization.

tasks.title: Inject failure and observe useful retry behavior
tasks.success_evidence: Show the failed task and blocked publication, then repaired quality and published receipt. Record attempts/run identity. Do not mark the task successful manually as a substitute for rerunning the test.

tasks.title: Prove output correctness after recovery
tasks.success_evidence: Correct final state is A: 150 / B: 100 / C: 0, one row per fund, successful quality and a receipt for the repaired run. Show unchanged output after another replay.

tasks.title: Use Astro UI to make an operational decision
tasks.success_evidence: Retain run/task identifiers and a description of the relevant log/state evidence. A hosted Astronomer route is optional and requires prepared access.

tasks.title: Write a short incident handoff
tasks.success_evidence: The handoff must explain blocked publication and correct recovered output. Optional stretch: connect an existing neutral alert transport or prepared Datadog monitor and demonstrate an actionable observation; configuration text alone is insufficient.

tasks.title: State the consumer population and grain
tasks.success_evidence: Record 10,000rawtrades, 2,500conformedportfolios and 1,028activeportfolios. Explain why a1472 portfolio gap is not proof of a missing ID column.

tasks.title: Build the valid-trade domain fact
tasks.success_evidence: Build and inspect 9,880validtrades; explain the 120 excluded rows. Check trade_id uniqueness/non-null and money/sign conversions on representative buy/sell examples.

tasks.title: Author the active portfolio summary
tasks.success_evidence: There must be3,717 positions and 1,028summaryportfolios. Check that every position portfolio is represented once in the summary. Explain the retained identifiers and native-currency valuation limit.

tasks.title: Investigate expected omission and a defective join
tasks.success_evidence: The defective query is an intentional teaching fixture, not a starter defect. Show its lost membership and repair on pf.advisor_id=a.advisor_id. Explain why blindly changing every join to LEFT JOIN would not define a correct all-portfolio report.

tasks.title: Prove minimum data quality and give a consumer handoff
tasks.success_evidence: All minimum tests pass with known counts. Hand over contract, authored files, representative rows, anti-join evidence and native-currency limitation. Use the supplied orchestration baseline to explain where this slice would execute; connected Atlas execution is a separate gate.

tasks.title: Build a meaningful performance report
tasks.success_evidence: One row per activeportfolio, 1,028 rows. Independently compare sample values and show a zero-volume example yields NULL rate. The output is a training report, not FX-converted economic AUM.

tasks.title: Rank advisor books with explicit ties
tasks.success_evidence: Show one row per representedadvisor, correct count/sums and equal rank for ties in the demonstration fixture. Explain why advisors with no active portfolio are outside this report population.

tasks.title: Build the regional rollup from its declared dependency
tasks.success_evidence: Inspect every regionalrow and verify the sum of portfolio counts is1,028. All represented advisors must belong to exactly one region in this fixture.

tasks.title: Reconcile independently and reject a defect
tasks.success_evidence: The wrong-key experiment must fail. Restored reports must agree perkey within declared numeric tolerance, have correct grains and retain the 1,028activepopulation. Save the failed assertion and repaired evidence.

tasks.title: Present a fixed completed core and select stretch
tasks.success_evidence: Core is complete only when the four output/proof themes are demonstrated. Optional stretch has separate estimates and never supplies missing minutes to this phase.
